text:
GitHub Copilot CLI just shipped HydraFusion, and the model picker might be the most useful part.

What changed: HydraFusion is a new experimental mode in Copilot CLI that routes a single task across local, cloud, and compound models instead of locking one model for the whole session.

What it actually does: it weighs cost, speed, and accuracy for the job in front of it and picks the model (or combination) that fits -- model choice becomes a routing decision, not a manual pick every time.

Builder value: we've said all season that model choice is a skill. This doesn't remove the skill, it makes the tradeoff visible. You see which model got picked and why, then override it when you know better.

Try this this week: open /experimental in Copilot CLI, turn on HydraFusion, and run the same task twice -- once on your default model, once with routing on. Compare what it picked.

The bigger signal: the fleet is becoming the default unit, not the model. Fluency now means knowing which model to reach for, and increasingly, knowing when to let the tool reach for you.

Save this for your AI stack.
